description.en: core, alloc, std and compiler_builtins, compiled into every native library.
description.zh: core、alloc、std 與 compiler_builtins，編進每一個原生程式庫。

description.en: UltraHonk prover and verifier statically linked into the native library (zkPDF, zkPassport).
description.zh: UltraHonk 證明與驗證器，靜態連結進原生程式庫（zkPDF、zkPassport）。

description.en: In the optional libdiw_bb5 library, which only verifies zkPassport proofs of circuits before 0.22.0.
description.zh: 在選用的 libdiw_bb5 程式庫中，只用來驗證 0.22.0 以前電路的 zkPassport 證明。

description.zh: 在 Android 上與 Barretenberg 一起靜態連結（c++_static）。

components.name: LLVM libc++, libc++abi, libunwind and compiler-rt (llvm-mingw)

description.en: Linked statically into the Windows native libraries; no GCC runtime is linked.
description.zh: 靜態連結進 Windows 原生程式庫，不含 GCC 執行階段。

description.zh: Windows 原生程式庫的 C 執行階段啟動碼（UCRT 本身屬於 Windows）。

components.name: Zig compiler-rt
components.copyright: Copyright (c) Zig contributors; parts derived from LLVM compiler-rt

description.en: Linked by Zig into the Linux compatibility libraries (and the full Linux libraries built with DIW_ZK_LINUX_LIBCXX=1).
description.zh: 由 Zig 連結進 Linux 相容版程式庫（以 DIW_ZK_LINUX_LIBCXX=1 建置的完整版亦同）。

description.en: Linked statically into full Linux libraries built with DIW_ZK_LINUX_LIBCXX=1.
description.zh: 靜態連結進以 DIW_ZK_LINUX_LIBCXX=1 建置的完整版 Linux 程式庫。

description.en: predicate.rs and zkid-mobile.patch, built into the age proof (OpenAC).
description.zh: predicate.rs 與 zkid-mobile.patch，編進年齡證明（OpenAC）。

description.en: Native libraries and default circuits for mdoc zero-knowledge presentation, distributed in multipaz-longfellow.
description.zh: mdoc 零知識出示的原生程式庫與預設電路，隨 multipaz-longfellow 散布。

components.name: Skia
components.copyright: Copyright (c) 2011 Google Inc. All rights reserved.

description.en: Graphics engine embedded in Skiko, with the third-party components Skia is built with.
description.zh: 內嵌在 Skiko 的繪圖引擎，含 Skia 建置時使用的第三方元件。

description.en: Database engine inside sqlite-jdbc.
description.zh: sqlite-jdbc 內的資料庫引擎。

description.en: Machine readable zone OCR, built into Tesseract4Android.
description.zh: 機器可讀區（MRZ）文字辨識，在 Tesseract4Android 內。

description.en: Image library used by Tesseract4Android.
description.zh: Tesseract4Android 使用的影像程式庫。

description.en: JPEG codec used by Tesseract4Android.
description.zh: Tesseract4Android 使用的 JPEG 編解碼器。

components.name: libpng
components.copyright: Copyright (c) 1995-2024 The PNG Reference Library Authors

description.en: PNG codec used by Tesseract4Android.
description.zh: Tesseract4Android 使用的 PNG 編解碼器。

description.en: WebAssembly matcher for receiving credentials through the Digital Credentials API (assets/openid4vci_provision.wasm).
description.zh: 以 Digital Credentials API 收卡時的 WebAssembly 比對程式（assets/openid4vci_provision.wasm）。

description.en: English OCR model for the machine readable zone (assets/tessdata).
description.zh: 機器可讀區的英文辨識模型（assets/tessdata）。

description.en: Face embedding model for zkPassport face match (assets/facenet/mobile_facenet.tflite, SHA-256 2254b01065c1f69ff501e9501042441b85323710e3d5a7b6be04a5084b647651).
description.zh: zkPassport 人臉比對的人臉特徵模型（assets/facenet/mobile_facenet.tflite，SHA-256 2254b01065c1f69ff501e9501042441b85323710e3d5a7b6be04a5084b647651）。

components.name: FaceNet-512 (InceptionResnetV1, VGGFace2 weights)
components.copyright: Copyright (c) 2019 Timothy Esler; port of facenet, Copyright (c) 2016 David Sandberg

description.en: Optional on-demand face embedding model (features/facenet), converted by this project to TFLite with int8 weights (SHA-256 4913ec9ad500ca9c977ac1386190dae274d5bcec6d997b9589c1d55e5f3e5746).
description.zh: 選用的隨選人臉特徵模型（features/facenet），由本專案轉成 int8 權重的 TFLite（SHA-256 4913ec9ad500ca9c977ac1386190dae274d5bcec6d997b9589c1d55e5f3e5746）。

description.en: Face detection model embedded in Multipaz FaceNet.
description.zh: 內嵌在 Multipaz FaceNet 的人臉偵測模型。

description.en: Passive anti-spoofing model embedded in Multipaz FaceNet.
description.zh: 內嵌在 Multipaz FaceNet 的被動防偽模型。

components.name: Self-declared FaceMatch circuit of this project

description.en: Compiled Noir circuit embedded in the native library, built with the zkPassport circuits libraries (utils, commitment, facematch, data-check, revision 2c5673df14d496a1b0baf7a92e883ca19fbb618b; Apache-2.0) and their Noir dependencies: noir-lang poseidon, noir_base64, noir_sort, noir_check_shuffle, sha256, zac-williamson sha1, zkPassport noir-bignum, noir-ecdsa, noir_rsa, noir_json_parser, sha512, noir_bigcurve (Apache-2.0); TACEO noir-poseidon and oprf-nr, noir-date (MIT).
description.zh: 內嵌在原生程式庫的已編譯 Noir 電路，以 zkPassport circuits 程式庫（utils、commitment、facematch、data-check，修訂 2c5673df14d496a1b0baf7a92e883ca19fbb618b；Apache-2.0）及其 Noir 相依建置：noir-lang poseidon、noir_base64、noir_sort、noir_check_shuffle、sha256、zac-williamson sha1、zkPassport noir-bignum、noir-ecdsa、noir_rsa、noir_json_parser、sha512、noir_bigcurve（Apache-2.0）；TACEO noir-poseidon 與 oprf-nr、noir-date（MIT）。

components.name: Key attestation FaceMatch circuits of this project

description.en: Downloaded when needed (the one circuit matching the device's attestation chain); built from native/circuits-zkpassport with the libraries of the self-declared circuit and the zkPassport sig-check library.
description.zh: 需要時下載（只下載符合這台裝置金鑰證明鏈的那一個）；以 native/circuits-zkpassport 及自我聲明版電路的程式庫與 zkPassport sig-check 程式庫建置。

components.name: zkPassport circuits, registry and certificate packages

description.en: Downloaded from zkpassport.id when a zkPassport request is answered or checked, and kept in the app's cache.
description.zh: 回應或查驗 zkPassport 請求時由 zkpassport.id 下載，保存在 App 的快取。

description.en: R1CS, proving and verifying keys and witness graphs of the age proof, compiled from zkID circuits (MIT) and circomlib 2.0.5 templates (GPL-3.0-or-later). Distributed separately under GPL-3.0, not linked into the native library. Corresponding source: zkID at the link above, https://github.com/iden3/circomlib/tree/v2.0.5 and @zk-email/circuits 6.3.4; rebuild with native/openac-age/build-graphs.sh.
description.zh: 年齡證明的 R1CS、證明與驗證金鑰及見證圖，由 zkID 電路（MIT）與 circomlib 2.0.5 範本（GPL-3.0-or-later）編譯。另以 GPL-3.0 散布，不連結進原生程式庫。對應原始碼：上方連結的 zkID、https://github.com/iden3/circomlib/tree/v2.0.5 與 @zk-email/circuits 6.3.4；以 native/openac-age/build-graphs.sh 重建。

description.en: Public ceremony transcript used by Barretenberg; hashes are pinned in native/zkpdf-prover/assets.json.
description.zh: Barretenberg 使用的公開儀式紀錄；雜湊釘選在 native/zkpdf-prover/assets.json。

components.name: W3C and W3C CCG JSON-LD contexts

description.en: Context documents built into core (w3c/ld/LdContexts.kt).
description.zh: 內建在 core 的 context 文件（w3c/ld/LdContexts.kt）。

components.name: Country signing CA certificates (BSI CSCA master list)

description.en: Public certificates of the issuing states, selected from the German CSCA master list and checked against BSI's self-signed root.
description.zh: 各發證國的公開憑證，選自德國 BSI 的 CSCA 主清單，並以 BSI 自簽根驗證。

description.en: Public certificates published by their certification authorities, by the e-sign platform esign.cn for its partner CAs and by the Multipaz project, reproduced for certificate path validation only.
description.zh: 各憑證機構、e簽寶（esign.cn）為合作 CA 及 Multipaz 專案公開的憑證，只用於憑證路徑驗證。

components.name: Adobe Approved Trust List and EU trusted lists

description.en: Downloaded and verified by the app when the trust settings turn them on; only the fingerprints of their signing certificates are built in.
description.zh: 在信任設定開啟時由 App 下載並驗證；只內建其簽署憑證的指紋。

components.name: Privileged browser list of Google Password Manager

description.en: Browsers allowed to pass a web origin to the Digital Credentials API (assets/privileged_user_agents.json).
description.zh: 可向 Digital Credentials API 傳遞網站來源的瀏覽器清單（assets/privileged_user_agents.json）。

components.name: C2PA soft binding algorithm list
components.copyright: Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity

description.en: Identifier, name, type, media types and description of each entry (core c2pa/SoftBindingAlgorithms.kt).
description.zh: 每個項目的識別碼、名稱、類型、媒體類型與說明（core 的 c2pa/SoftBindingAlgorithms.kt）。

description.en: The JBIG2 decoder in core (document/image/Jbig2.kt) follows ITU-T T.88 and the structure of the pdf.js decoder.
description.zh: core 的 JBIG2 解碼器（document/image/Jbig2.kt）依 ITU-T T.88 並參照 pdf.js 解碼器的結構撰寫。

description.en: A jlink image of the Java runtime packaged in the installers; its legal folder holds the notices of the components OpenJDK includes. The jar distributions carry no Java runtime.
description.zh: 安裝檔附帶的 Java 執行環境（jlink 映像），其 legal 資料夾有 OpenJDK 內含元件的聲明。jar 版本不附 Java 執行環境。

components.name: GraalVM Community native-image (Substrate VM and JDK class library)

description.en: Runtime compiled into the experimental native executables, with the JDK native libraries (awt, jawt, j2pcsc and others) beside them.
description.zh: 編進實驗原生執行檔的執行環境，以及放在旁邊的 JDK 原生程式庫（awt、jawt、j2pcsc 等）。

description.en: Statically linked into this project's AppImage runtime (tools/appimage-runtime, Apache-2.0); no FUSE library is used.
description.zh: 靜態連結進本專案的 AppImage 執行階段（tools/appimage-runtime，Apache-2.0）；不使用 FUSE 程式庫。

components.name: Rust crates of the AppImage runtime
components.license: (MIT OR Apache-2.0) AND MIT AND Zlib AND BSL-1.0

description.en: backhand, deku, flate2, zlib-rs, bitvec, xxhash-rust, solana-nohash-hasher and their dependencies, statically linked into the AppImage runtime with the Rust standard library; exact versions are in tools/appimage-runtime/Cargo.lock.
description.zh: backhand、deku、flate2、zlib-rs、bitvec、xxhash-rust、solana-nohash-hasher 及其相依，與 Rust 標準函式庫一起靜態連結進 AppImage 執行階段；確切版本見 tools/appimage-runtime/Cargo.lock。
